definition: For q=lambda_eff*onehot(yA)+(1-lambda_eff)*onehot(yB), CE(q,p)=H(q)+KL(q||p). H(q) is binary entropy(lambda_eff) for different labels and zero for equal labels. lambda_eff is recomputed from the clipped integer rectangle area.
weighting: Each batch contribution is weighted by its actual sample count; each epoch contains 45000 samples, with 352 batches and 72 samples in the last batch. Window means average equal-size epochs.
weighted_accuracy_upper_bound_definition: Mean max_c(q_c): 1 for same-class pairs, max(lambda_eff,1-lambda_eff) for different classes. This is the target-based ceiling of the recorded mixed-label weighted correctness, not a bound below 100% for ordinary clean classification accuracy.

replay.source: E4 initial.pt NumPy and training DataLoader generator states; only labels at manifest train indices entered calculations
replay.rng_order_per_batch: Beta(alpha,alpha), permutation(batch_size), randint(W), randint(H); application probability is exactly 1 so no probability gate draw occurs
replay.rectangle_rule: cut_w=floor(W*sqrt(1-lambda_raw)); cut_h analogous; left=cx-cut_w//2; right=left+cut_w; top=cy-cut_h//2; bottom=top+cut_h; endpoints clipped independently; NCHW and half-open [y1:y2,x1:x2]

notes: All entropy and KL values use natural logarithms (nats). The residual is epoch recorded training CE minus exact target entropy, so floating-point training roundoff carries into the residual.

Replay uses actual training-label pairing, not an assumed probability of same/different class. Reading CIFAR-10 train=True obtains labels; no test dataset, image transformations or model forward are used.
Zero-area rectangles are legitimate outcomes of integer rounding and remain marked applied; their effective source-label weight is one.
Raw and effective lambda differ because of integer sizes and boundary clipping. The retained-area mean near 0.69 is an observed distribution, not a fixed label coefficient.
Correlation of total CE with target entropy does not mean all variation is irreducible: excess KL also changes with mixture difficulty and can still improve.
Nonzero CutMix CE or a mixed-label weighted accuracy below 100% cannot by themselves show lack of convergence; compare the clean validation metrics and the residual trend.
